description: Mobile Synchronization & Retry Logic Improvements - Implement proper idempotency, controlled retry logic with exponential backoff, and prevent overlapping requests to handle unreliable rural mobile connections safely.
steps: Add idempotency keys to clocking and evidence upload requests to prevent duplicate records on retry
Update HttpClientService retry logic to respect project guidelines - max 2 retries total, never retry 4xx errors, add exponential backoff with jitter
Modify persistent_sync_service.dart to prevent overlapping sync operations using proper locking mechanisms
Add request deduplication to manual_clocking_evidence_sync_service.dart to prevent duplicate evidence uploads
Implement proper queue management in signature_geofence_clock_in_page.dart to handle connection interruptions gracefully
Add circuit breaker pattern to HttpClientService to temporarily disable failing endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Repeated identical requests create only one clocking record due to idempotency keys
HTTP client never retries authentication errors (401/403) or validation errors (422)
Sync operations use exponential backoff: 1s, 2s delays with jitter to prevent thundering herd
Multiple concurrent sync attempts are prevented through proper coordination
Failed requests remain queued locally and resume when connectivity restored
Circuit breaker temporarily disables endpoints after 5 consecutive failures
verification: Test duplicate request handling by simulating network timeouts during clocking submission
Verify 4xx errors are not retried by testing with invalid authentication tokens
Test exponential backoff timing by monitoring request logs during simulated network issues
Test concurrent sync prevention by triggering multiple sync operations simultaneously
Test offline queue persistence by disconnecting during sync and reconnecting later
